en: A black and white image of a European public square dominated by an ornate column monument decorated with baroque sculptures, surrounded by a wrought iron fence. The backdrop includes an elaborate Neo-Gothic or late 19th-century building with stepped gables, a church tower with a central clock, and several old townhouses. The square is relatively empty, with a few people in early 20th-century dress walking about. A sign on one of the buildings shows the text 'CONDITOREI'.
